name: Phantasy Star II Text Adventure: Shilka no Bouken
original_name: ファンタシースターII テキストアドベンチャー シルカの冒険
source:
Phantasy Star II Text Adventures were a series of eight text adventure videogames available to users of Sega Meganet, a modem for the Sega Mega Drive in Japan, and later released as part of two compilations on the Sega Mega-CD. Each of the games takes place shortly before Phantasy Star II, documenting the backgrounds of its characters, and explaining what brings them to the town Paseo where they eventually team up to investigate the pervasive troubles of the Algol Solar System.

Shilka's Adventure

Shir Gold (Japanese: シルカ・レビニア (Shiruka Rebinia, Shilka Levinia)) – the only child of a wealthy family in Paseo, she belongs to the well-to-do of Motavia. Growing up and wanting for nothing, Shir felt that becoming a thief would remedy the monotony of daily life. She enjoys the outside air, the cool night breeze, and hanging around on rooftops, taking up the nickname "Shir of the Wind". Her adventure takes place in Autumn of AW 1282, about two years before the events that take place in Phantasy Star II, as she plans to steal a valuable painting entitled "Opa-Opa", which is on display in a hotel exhibit.

[From: [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phantasy_Star_II_Text_Adventures]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
《梦幻之星II文字冒险》是由八部文字冒险游戏组成的系列，最初面向日本世嘉Mega Drive调制解调器Sega Meganet用户推出，后来作为两部合集的一部分登陆世嘉Mega-CD。每部游戏都发生在《梦幻之星II》正篇稍早之前，讲述各角色的背景，以及他们如何来到帕塞欧镇，最终结成队伍，共同调查阿尔戈尔太阳系不断蔓延的危机。

希尔卡的冒险

希尔·戈尔德（日文名：シルカ・レビニア）是帕塞欧一个富裕家庭的独生女，属于莫塔维亚的上流阶层。从小衣食无忧的她认为，成为盗贼能够打破单调日常。她喜欢外面的空气、凉爽夜风，也喜欢待在屋顶上，因此得到“风之希尔”的别名。她的冒险发生在AW 1282年秋天，距离《梦幻之星II》事件约两年。此时，她计划偷走一幅名为《Opa-Opa》的珍贵画作，作品正在一家酒店的展览中公开陈列。
